speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Off. It held. Do not do it again in the passage for the pleasure of having done it.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I came on the whistle. Once. They were busy with the gentlemen.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Busy is the right size of an afternoon. Thou wert clean, Nick. Leave it clean.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: John will ask if I was late. I was not late.

speaker: john_heminges
text: I am asking now, and I heard the whistle from the stair. Thou wert not late. That is the whole of my interest in thy feet.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then we are spared a report. I was in it. I am going home.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: The Rose is still dark. I walked past this morning and the flag was not up. Do not ask me what they took. I do not know it, and I would not repeat it if a doorkeeper had shouted a figure.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Dark since Thursday. That is enough to know. A sum is not mine.

speaker: john_heminges
text: A sum is not yours, and it is not mine from their door. Their house is shut. Ours was open. That is the difference I will write, and nothing beside it.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Is the other book in the house? I like to know what I am not to touch.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Garnish has it. It is not in this room. A tiring-house is a good place to forget a king for one night.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Forgotten until I am asked. Six days from yesterday. I am not counting his leaves for him.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Do not. Monday is the carry, and Monday is not tomorrow. Tomorrow you rehearse, and tomorrow you play, and the king is neither of those.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I know the afternoon I am in. I do not know a road.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Kemp was loud in the passage about roads. I am only reporting the noise. I am not voting.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Then report it once and stop. The roads are not a boy's news. There is no reckoning today, and there is no answer tonight.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Home, Will. Same road you came. The watch at the gate looks at a face whether the face has played or not.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Same road. I have nothing in my hands.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Shall I walk with you as far as the gate?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Walk with John. Aldermanbury is thy door. Mine is the other way once we are through.

speaker: john_heminges
text: He walks with me. Thou hast a supper that is not a council. Go to thine.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: And leave the whistle where it was. One clean door is a good day. Two would be vanity.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: One is enough. I prefer a yard that is loud. This one was busy, which is near enough.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Near enough. I am gone.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Gone, then. If she asks the plot, give her a short one. She has had a king this week already.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will give her nothing that sounds like a speech. I mean to be home before the house is barred.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: See that you are. Off, the lot of you. The yard is empty, and I would like the tiring-house to be empty too.
